# `assets/vehicle/VehicleMath.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/vehicle/VehicleMath.js`

engine/assets/vehicle/VehicleMath.js — minimal column-major 4x4 + quaternion helpers for vehicle rig assembly and the visual wheel transform chain. Kept local and dependency-free so the vehicle layer is self-contained and the math stays deterministic (and gate-testable without the renderer).

## Functions

### `identity()`

### `multiply(a, b)`

Column-major multiply: out = a * b.

### `composeTRS(t = [0, 0, 0], q = [0, 0, 0, 1], s = 1)`

Compose a TRS matrix (scale may be a number or [x,y,z]).

### `quatFromAxisAngle(axis, angle)`

Quaternion (xyzw) from an axis + angle (radians).

### `quatMul(a, b)`

Hamilton product a*b (xyzw).

### `transformPoint(m, p)`

Transform a point (vec3) by a column-major 4x4.

### `nodeLocalMatrix(node)`

Local transform of a node (matrix override or TRS).

### `computeWorldMatrices(model)`

World matrices for every node, accumulating the parent chain. Returns a Map(nodeId → Float32Array(16)).
